newsitem.title: FRANCE: Remy Cointreau nine month sales edge up.
newsitem.headline: Remy Cointreau nine month sales edge up.

text.p: (All figures in millions of French francs)
Remy Martin sales recovered overall, with healthy rises in U.S. and China sales compensating for falls in Europe and Japan, the group said in a statement.
Cointreau sales rose significantly at the end of the year, lifting sales in the liqueurs, wines and spirits division.

Sales of Piper-Heidsieck, Charles Heidsieck and Krug rose 12 percent, it said, adding that sales total for the champagne division did not rise by this amount in the wake of an end to the stock sales within the trade in the comparable period.

Sales of partner brands were attributed to recent distribution deals and development of portfolio labels, such as Famous Grouse, Macallan, Antinori and Jim Beam and distribution in Japan of wines Louis Latour, Baron Philippe de Rothschild, Domaine d'Ott and Paul Jaboulet Aine.
